claim: Medical progress adds at least a year of remaining life annually.
originalWording: Medical progress adds at least a year of remaining life annually.

sources.title: AI escape velocity: A conversation with Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: Claims are shown as paraphrases unless identified as a verified quotation.

reference.criterion: Medical progress adds at least one year of remaining healthy life per calendar year for the relevant people.
reference.rationale: The stated 2029 date remains future. Medical gains and changing period life expectancy do not demonstrate sustained longevity escape velocity. Current progress is partial, not evidence that the threshold was crossed.
